notes.title: 🚀 Astra Sentinel Demo is Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Commanders, the time has come![/p][p]We're excited to announce that the [b]demo for [i]Astra Sentinel[/i] is now available[/b]. You can now try a first glimpse of the large-scale strategic space combat we've been passionately working on.[/p][list][*][p]Explore, build, and defend your star system from the alien swarm.[/p][/*][*][p]This demo features a special mission designed to showcase the core mechanics of the game.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]💬 Found a bug? Got feedback?[/b][/p][p]We want [i]Astra Sentinel[/i] to be the best it can be, and your feedback is incredibly valuable.
Inside the demo, you'll find a [b]feedback button[/b] that lets you send your comments or bug reports directly to us. We’re reading everything![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for trying the demo, we hope you enjoy this first taste of the [i]Astra Sentinel[/i] universe.
See you on the battlefield among the stars![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Concluded & Upcoming Demo
notes.content: [p]The playtest for [i]Astra Sentinel[/i] has officially ended, and we've now disabled access. We want to extend a massive thank you to everyone who participated and shared their thoughts. Your feedback has been incredibly valuable![/p][p]Thanks to all the input from our playtesters, we've made a lot of improvements and we're excited to announce that a brand-new [b]demo[/b] is coming [b]very soon[/b]![/p][p]This upcoming demo will feature:[/p][list][*][p][b]Several planets[/b] to defend and colonize.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlockable difficulty levels[/b] for added replayability.[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] based on your suggestions.[/p][/*][/list][p]We can't wait to show you how much the game has evolved. Stay tuned for the demo launch, it's just around the corner![/p]

notes.title: Astra Sentinel - The Playtest is Open!
notes.content:
The first public playtest of Astra Sentinel is now open!

This is an early version of the game so expect bugs, limited content, and a focus on testing. In this build, you'll defend a single planet from 3 enemy waves.

Our main goal is to gather data on performance, stability, and potential bugs to improve the game.

A future demo will introduce colonization mechanics and multiple planets, so stay tuned!

🙏 Thanks to everyone participating  your help is invaluable to us. Please share your feedback using the form inside the game!

Happy gaming,
Somnambulist Games team.

notes.title: Astra Sentinel - Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the Astra Sentinel playtest will be opening soon! 🚀 You can now request access, and Steam will notify you when the test goes live. The Playtest will be open to all participants.

This playtest is an opportunity to evaluate the game's technical aspects and performance. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game!

Please note:
[list]
[*] This is a [b]technical test[/b], so expect some bugs and unfinished features.
[*] [b]Content is limited[/b] at this stage, as the focus is on testing [b]performance and stability.[/b]
[/list]
Thank you to all players who join the test, we truly appreciate your support! 🙌

Happy gaming,
Somnambulist Games team.
